docs.title: ITS Core Ontology
docs.text:
This ontology defines core concepts related to intelligent transport systems (ITS).

License: http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

This ontology imports the following files:

  • https://w3id.org/citydata/part2/v1/CityPattern

docs.title: ActivationStatusCode
docs.text:
A code indicating the activation status of an object

EXAMPLE: active, beingSetUp, beingShutDown, inactive, scheduled

docs.title: Diagram
docs.text:
SVG (interactive)PNG

cluster_associated Code Code ITSThing ITSThing ActivationStatusCode ActivationStatusCode ActivationStatusCode->Code ActivationStatusCode->ITSThing

docs.title: Formalization for ActivationStatusCode
docs.text: Property Constraint subClassOf ITSThing subClassOf Code

docs.text: Class Description Bearing The orientation of a line or movement, measured from north (0°) clockwise.

docs.title: Bearing
docs.text:
The orientation of a line or movement, measured from north (0°) clockwise.

EXAMPLE: 0°, 90°, 180°, 270°, 360°

docs.title: Diagram
docs.text:
SVG (interactive)PNG

cluster_associated Angle Angle Direction Direction Bearing Bearing Bearing->Angle Bearing->Direction

docs.title: Formalization for Bearing
docs.text: Property Constraint subClassOf Direction subClassOf Angle

docs.title: Code
docs.text: A code value whose meaning is defined by membership in (or reference to) a code list.

docs.text:

cluster_associated cdm2_Code cdm2:Code ITSThing ITSThing Code Code codeValue : xsd:string [1] Code->cdm2_Code Code->ITSThing CodeList CodeList Code->CodeList fromCodeList 1

docs.title: Specializations of Code
docs.text: Class Description Activation Status Code A code indicating the activation status of an object Comparison Operator Code A code representing a comparison operator. Direction Code A code representing orientation of a line or movement.

docs.title: Formalization for Code
docs.text: Property Constraint codeValue exactly 1 xsd:string fromCodeList exactly 1 CodeList subClassOf ITSThing subClassOf cdm2:Code

docs.title: ComparisonOperatorCode
docs.text:
A code representing a comparison operator.

EXAMPLE: equals, not equals, greater than, less than, greater than or equal to, less than or equal to
